analysis.dominant_degradation: structured quasi-periodic chromatic interference / moire-like field (wavy, warped, spatially varying color modulation) spanning the whole frame; no x_distortion operator reproduces it
analysis.reasoning: Signals from run_full_analysis are mutually inconsistent across the five support pairs (global verdict flips between brighten/darken/contrast-strengthen/none; block_boundary 1.015-1.119; sigma_prior 1.1-2.2), while the residual is a coherent smooth field. Every tested library candidate stays at or below the clean-vs-target no-op PSNR, because the structured pattern dominates the error. All candidates < 30 dB, therefore POOR and alternatives are left empty per SKILL rules.

tested_candidates.assessment: library noise floor far above estimate; white noise cannot reproduce coherent field

best_library_fit.note: Reported only as the closest single library operator. It is statistically indistinguishable from doing nothing and is NOT asserted as the true degradation. Do not treat as a confident prediction.
